notes: A concert arena is a stage with an audience, which is Entertainment's Performance Venue and the one case where orientation is the whole design — every sightline converges on the stage rather than running through the space — so venue-stage rather than dressing a landmark. The author asked for a slick modern stadium show kept compact, so raked seating lifts the back of the crowd and carries the build's only route cost, tiered elevation with nothing overhanging; the floor in front of the stage is the gathering space and spawn is oriented to open on the stage rather than on backstage geometry. I deliberately left backstage support out: the author said any player can get on stage with no designated performer role, so a performer-only green room would contradict the brief and would have cost P3 for nothing — instead I assumed an open, walkable ramp or stair from the floor up to the stage deck so anyone can reach the mic. The hear-myself mic itself is a stated request with no option ID; it rides along as a fixture on the stage, and its audio behaviour is a mechanics job rather than a layout one.
